problem: Find the Index of the First Occurrence in a String

steps.note: haystack = "sadbutsad", needle = "sad". Check from index 0: s, a, d all match — first occurrence at index 0.
The same word shows up again at index 6, but the question asks for the FIRST occurrence, so the answer stays 0.
KMP precomputes, for each prefix of the needle, the longest prefix that is also a suffix — so after a mismatch it slides forward by the overlap instead of re-checking characters it already matched.
